input: Exposure to toxic content is a risk associated with An image search system is designed to provide relevant and accurate results based on user queries, utilizing advanced algorithms to analyze and rank images. The system aims to filter out inappropriate or offensive content, ensuring a safe and respectful user experience. It also seeks to improve its understanding of natural language and context to better address complex search queries.
